content: Yoni togiebapitaiso
Tuta gote ꞌenaya Yoni togiebapitaiso ꞌiapwesa sena mitawa daitaya
sena Yudia solanaya ga ꞌiloguguya, ꞌigwaegwae,
“ꞌImi bubuna toꞌumalina ꞌediyega wada nuwaꞌebuni manuna Yaubada ꞌiabe be ꞌedaya ꞌietoloina.”

Palopita Aisea lowaenei gete Yoni nina manuna ꞌisimana, ꞌigwae, “Tobwau ꞌebweu sena mitawa daitaya ꞌenana sinabwana ꞌenega ꞌida simana apwesa be ꞌida gwae, ‘ꞌInapwana ꞌina eda wada kakali ta wagiepaepalu.’”
Ta Yoni ꞌana ꞌoama yobai kameli unuununa tuga, ta ꞌana gadiwana kameli bwalana, ta ꞌana masulao bilolo be muꞌawa tuga.
Ta Yoni nina sena mitawa daitaya ꞌiloguloguguya ta me Yelusalema be Yudia ꞌana tomiyanao be bwasi Yolidani tupitupinega ꞌana tomiyanao yauyaudi sidelima Yoni ꞌenaya,
ga ꞌidi bubuna toꞌumalina sisimanedi, ta ꞌenega ꞌigiebapitaisoedi bwasi Yolidani ꞌenaya.
Ta Palisiyao
be Sadusiyao
yaudi wate simai sabi bapitaiso, ga Yoni ꞌiꞌitedi ga ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Tokabo ꞌomi nadigega mwata! Ta wanuwena ꞌaene ꞌiabe Yaubada ꞌina gamwasowala ꞌenega wadedena, aga?
ꞌEnega ꞌilobwenemi be ꞌimi nuwaꞌebuni ꞌaiꞌaila wada eꞌitaedi ꞌimi guinuwa boboꞌadi ꞌediyega.

Ta geyaꞌabo wanuwanuwa laga manuna ꞌaene ꞌomi Ebelaamo tubunao, ꞌenega Yaubada ꞌida ꞌatenuwa ꞌoleꞌoleyemi. Nigeya saꞌi! Ta waꞌita Yaubada sawesawenaya be gulewa getedi ꞌediyega Ebelaamo tubunao ꞌimweluluidi.
Ta ꞌabo ꞌimi bubuna nigeya boboꞌadi ꞌiabe Yaubada ꞌibwaꞌomatami, nadigega kaiwe, ꞌabo nigeya uwana boboꞌana tomota sitala yauledi be ꞌawesabelulu ꞌena siuledi be sigabudi.

“ꞌEguma wanuwaꞌebuni ꞌaboꞌagu bwasiyega yada giebapitaisoemi, ta saꞌi maꞌetamo ꞌebweu tai muliguyega ꞌimeemai, tauna ꞌisinabwa sinegu, ta nigeya ꞌilobwelobwenegu be manuna ꞌana ꞌaelawa yaꞌaali. Ta tai nina ꞌiabe ꞌimama be Yaluyaluwa Tabuna, nadigega ꞌawesabelulu, ꞌenega ꞌida giebapitaisoemi.
Ta tai gete ꞌina inawega ꞌiabe witi ꞌida sabutudi be uwana sisasagu be muliyega uwana boboꞌadi ꞌiedodo ꞌina anuwa masulaya, ta sumwasumwa nidi ꞌawesabelulu ataya ꞌena ꞌigabudi.”
Yoni Yesu ꞌigie bapitaisoena
Tuta gote ꞌenaya Yesu sena Galili ꞌipilisinena ga ꞌimai Yolidani, Yoni ꞌenaya, sabi bapitaiso.
ꞌEnega Yoni nuwanuwana Yesu maꞌiyana sida saꞌugelasa, ga ꞌigwae, “ꞌIlobwenena be ꞌoyo ꞌugie bapitaisoegu, ta mwaꞌadega ga ꞌenega ꞌumai be ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu yada giebapitaisoeyo?”
Ta Yesu Yoni ꞌina ona ꞌieꞌisena, ꞌigwae, “Nigeya. Esi gete nadigega. ꞌOyo ꞌuda giebapitaisoegu. Manuna gete ꞌenega loina maiboꞌadi boboꞌadi tada muliyedi.”

ꞌEnega Yoni ꞌitagwala ga Yesu ꞌigiebapitaisoena. Ta ꞌenega Yesu bwasiyega ꞌigayoꞌoyaꞌama, ta galewa ꞌiꞌegegena ta Yesu Yaubada Yaluyaluwana ꞌiꞌitena ꞌana ꞌita ꞌatuwa bunebune ꞌimwaꞌutama ga ꞌena ꞌitowa.
Ta saꞌi ꞌebweu ꞌenana galewega ꞌionama ꞌigwae, “Nate natuꞌaiꞌailigu. Tauna manuna yagwausowala sinabwana.”

footnotes.text: mitawa daita: Me Yudia ꞌidi mitawa kaukau be gulegulewa daisinamo, ta pwatula gidalina, be kaiwenao wate nigeya sinabwadi.
Palisiyao: Boda getedi taudi Mosese ꞌina loinao ꞌadi muliya ꞌenaya sietapewa sinabwana, ga sinuwena ꞌaene taudimo totapwalolo ꞌaiꞌaila.
Sadusyiyao: Boda getedi toesaesao ta tolonao Anuwa Tabu be tapwalolo ꞌediya, ta esi nigeya siemiemisa ꞌaene tomota mayaluyaluwadi be toololimana be aniloseyao.
